title: Adverse event reports for Tumor Treating Fields devices in the FDA MAUDE database: code, codebook and annotations
description: Code, classification codebook and annotations for an analysis of 548 adverse event reports for Tumor Treating Fields devices in the US FDA MAUDE database (2012 to 2025), including human, rule-based and large language model classifications of the report narratives. MAUDE narratives are not redistributed; they are retrieved from openFDA by the included scripts.
